يستنجوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْجُوا (yastanjū) /jas.tan.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# يُسْتَنْجَوْا (yustanjaw) /jus.tan.d͡ʒaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
